about_the_game:
No Time to Build is a fun cooperative casual game with parkour elements, where you’ll work together to overcome obstacles and build bridges. Alongside your partner, you’ll gather logs, avoid traps, and finish tasks within the allotted time.

Cooperative Chaos!

The game is designed for two players, making teamwork even more essential. Coordinate your actions to gather resources faster and bypass obstacles. But be careful – random collisions can knock you down!

Physics and Parkour!

Dynamic levels are full of challenges: moving platforms, disappearing paths, ladders, trains, and even walking bombs! Each level will test your agility and strategic thinking.

Build Faster – Time is Running Out!

Your main goal is to gather enough logs to complete the construction. But time is tight, and the map is full of tricky obstacles, so you’ll need to act quickly and in sync!

Mechanics and Unique Features

  • Break Objects! Chop down trees and gather logs by pressing the E key.

  • Transport Resources! Deliver the logs to the construction zone to see bridges being built.

  • Parkour and Traps! Jump over obstacles, avoid trains, and escape from walking bombs.

  • Interactive Elements! Use portals for instant log transportation and boost bushes for maximum speed.

  • Player Interactions! Push each other, accidentally collide – but remember, every player who falls slows down the process!

Characters and Customization

All players have the same abilities but can stand out through customization! The store offers hats, character rings, and even walking particle effects. You can also improve your speed and jump using in-game currency.

Locations

  • 🌾 Farm

  • 🏙 City

  • ❄ Winter

  • 🤠 Wild West

Complete all the levels, showcase your agility and teamwork to finish construction on time! Ready for the challenge? Then let's go – No Time to Build! 🚀

short_description: No Time to Build is a cooperative casual game with parkour and action elements! Collect logs, avoid cars, trains, and walking bombs, overcome challenges, and build structures within the time limit. Teleports, speed-boosting bushes, and player interactions make every game chaotic and fun!
